name: Setsugekka
message: 「Pa-pa-ra-pa-pa-pa-paa~, pa-pa-ra-pa-paa~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Pa-pa-ra-pu-pa-pa-ra-pu-pa-pa-ra-pu-paaa~~~！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「SO ANNOOOOYIIING！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oi, oi~! Any sleepyheads in here~? I’ll try waking you up gently, but if you don’t get up, I’m gonna wallop you~!」
...It’s been a few days since Setsugekka started coming to wake me up in the morning.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Morning, Momimomi♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「Morning, Setsugekka♪」

name: Momiji
message: 「As if I’d say that! Give it a rest already!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Imagine how it feels to have to listen to that moronic voice every single morning right after waking up.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Who are you calling moronic, you jerk~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How dare you complain about such a magnificent, lovely voice! Who do you think you are, huh?!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, god, you’re so tedious...」
Just the annoyance of it is enough to give me indigestion this early. I collapse back onto the bed.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, don’t go back to sleep. We’re already cutting it pretty close, you know~. Come on, get dressed.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Stop acting like my mother.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Also, I don’t think leaving your panties and bras lying around like this is a very good idea, Momiji~」
Setsugekka starts gathering up the laundry.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What if the teacher comes in and sees them？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t care, he can look all he wants.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, that’s a bad look for a maiden, seriously.」
She starts rustling about, gathering the trash scattered on the floor into a bag.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Honestly, you should at least tidy up after yourself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s fine, since you’ll do it for me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don’t make others do your work for you!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ouch.」
I got slapped on the butt.

name: Momiji
message: 「Then why are you cleaning it up for me, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Because it’s a total eyesore, obviously. Come on, hurry up and get up!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I bought some cereal, so let’s eat together.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah~」
I crawl out of bed and sit at the table.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Itadakimasu~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Itadakima~」
Crunch, crunch.
Eating breakfast together had already become part of our daily routine after a few days.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, is it good？」

name: Momiji
message: 「……It’s super weird. What is this?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Garlic & Honey Margarine flavor. I was curious, so I picked it up!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't be so adventurous~ plain is fine, you know.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're pretty arrogant for someone who's having me do the shopping for them!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haha~, I am blessed~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You don't sound grateful at all.」
Crunch, crunch.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Hey, Momimomi. I've been wondering about something.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Are we friends, I wonder？」
……Friends, huh.

name: Momiji
message: 「If thou deemest them a friend, then surely they shall deem thee a friend as well~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why’d you say that like a monk?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, I guess we’re friends then, right？」
Surely…… once I win the Martial Festival, we probably won't be friends anymore.
But even so, if Setsugekka wants to be friends—

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I suppose that’s fine, nya~」
For now, let's just say we're friends.
